changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A closed rule of person_row_sweep expires an account's ready exports when an erasure or an edit changes one of their sources, ordered against the export worker by the account's export fence.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: An account export holds its owner's conversation messages and received feedback. When an erasure, an edit, a withdrawal or a retraction changes one of them, in the same transaction, the triggers call EXPORT_SOURCES_CHANGED for the owner. A ready export is published only under the owner's export fence.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Wrong rows: a ready export built before the fence can hold a conversation message or feedback that an erasure removed after the export was built, and nothing writes that export again before it expires. Every ready export expires once, and its owner requests a new one.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.account_export SET status = 'EXPIRED', payload = NULL WHERE status = 'READY'

rollback.stop: This step cleared payloads that can hold erased words, so it cannot be reversed. To roll back further, restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup, then expire its ready exports before any server serves a download.
